benefits.name: Korean Air Lounge Vouchers
benefits.description: Two complimentary Korean Air Lounge vouchers each year.
benefits.terms: Issued to the primary cardmember after account opening and each anniversary date after the annual fee is paid on time. Vouchers are valid for 1 year from the date of issue.

benefits.name: 5% Korean Air Ticket Discount
benefits.description: One 5% discount coupon on Korean Air tickets each year, usable for the cardmember and a companion.
benefits.terms: Primary cardmember receives one 5% discount coupon at account opening and each account anniversary year. Applies to qualified Korean Air ticket purchases on koreanair.com made within one year from the date the coupon is deposited.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Insurance coverage for car rentals made with the card.
benefits.terms: Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Visa Guide to Benefits for coverage details.

earningRates.terms: Eligible Korean Air ticket purchases made through Korean Air ticket agents or koreanair.com. Excludes award tickets, upgrade awards, and tickets that include other airlines' flights.
Gas stations, EV charging stations, office supply stores, cell phone service providers, restaurants, fast-food restaurants and bars (including takeout and restaurant delivery).
